prerequisites: D1 rights/institutional conditions explicitly addressed for the exact proposed use; accepted R12 is not clearance.
Owner approves D2 policy scope and separately grants participant projection/read/output authority.
Pin exact restricted carrier paths and hashes, permitted fields, staging/runtime and sealed comparison references; no latest-file fallback.
Confirm no source/artifact overwrite and define retention/output disclosure conditions; Stata MCP only for all participant/statistical checks.

operations.name: Historical membership and eligibility support
operations.proposal: Under separate authority compare exact retained submission-key membership to preserved423reference and manual exclusion provenance; evaluate instrument response predicates only. Keep exclusions unchanged. Migration/return/residence can be supported or indeterminate; do not infer positive status from nationality/year alone.
operations.outputs: Restricted aggregate mismatch/indeterminate summary; no respondent key list; no names/phones/admin matching.

operations.name: Version/route/domain state audit
operations.proposal: Assess actualversion domains/routes, unavailable items, applicable nonresponse and parent/dummy concordance for a pinned dependency allowlist; do not recode participant values.
operations.outputs: Restricted item/version aggregate state ledger, disclosure-reviewed before any possible public output.

operations.name: Time/geography lineage audit
operations.proposal: Check recorded datefield/order consistency and version-aware residence/stage grouping discrepancies without timestamp normalization, locality imputation or geographic pooling.
operations.outputs: Restricted aggregate discrepancy ledger; no row-level coordinates/dates or tiny joint cells in public materials.

operations.name: Analysis sample/denominator accounting
operations.proposal: Use pinned existing recipes/outcome roles to document each permitted question/score/model denominator, distinguishing observable completeness from an actual estimator's sample. No new estimation, scores, categories or prediction.
operations.outputs: Restricted aggregate design/denominator map; do not claim fitted e(sample) from complete-case arithmetic.

prohibited: Fits/refits, bootstrap, random starts or resampling
Participant exports, keys, contacts, free text or individual predictions/classes
Matching names/phones or opening administrative lists
Filtering, reinstatement, new exclusions, imputation, weighting, category/score/geography/time changes
Qualitative inspection/editing, contacts, submissions, releases, commits/pushes or live Overleaf/cloud actions
failure_handling: Stop on unpinned carrier/field/output, ownership mismatch, unexpected version/domain, preservation drift, missing authority or unresolved scientific choice. Preserve failed receipts; no automatic repair or alternate source.
limits: This is a substantive validation design, not a dispatch adapter or operational acceptance. It specifies no real path/hash/field grant now and cannot execute.
